title: Define safe TUI command grammar
purpose: Define a typed TUI command grammar that routes operator intent to existing runtime APIs and rejects shell-like execution.
scope: Define semantic command ids for intent, run, audit, support and aom operations.
Define parser output type and error model.
Reject shell fragments, pipes, redirection and unknown commands.
Map each accepted command to its owning subsystem.
Document that command parsing does not execute side effects.
acceptance_criteria: Every TUI command has a typed owner and no raw shell execution path.
Approval commands require run id, step id and actor context.
aom commands are lifecycle projections or activation previews only.
Parser failure is explainable and fail-closed.
failure_modes: Command grammar accepts shell-like syntax as executable input.
Approval mutation is possible through partial command parameters.
Unknown commands silently fall back to host shell.
